System Administration

System-wide administration tasks including security configuration, database health, and maintenance.

admin_security

Admin security router for session management and spillage remediation.

This module provides the administrative security endpoints required by UK MOD JSP 440 / JSP 604 and US DoD IL5/IL6 guidelines:

  1. Heartbeat — Client-side session keep-alive to prevent inactivity timeout (POST /api/v1/auth/heartbeat).

  2. Spillage Purge — Multi-signature emergency data redaction for classified spillage events (POST /api/v1/admin/security/spillage/purge).

  3. Audit Certificates — Historic spillage redaction certificates for external security accreditation boards (GET /api/v1/admin/security/spillage/audit-certificates).

Session Heartbeat

In a SCIF environment, an unattended terminal is a security risk. The client sends periodic heartbeat pings to keep the session alive. If the elapsed time since the last heartbeat exceeds 900 seconds (15 minutes), the session is invalidated and the client receives HTTP 401 with header X-Session-Terminated: INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT.

Spillage Purge

When classified data is accidentally disclosed to an unauthorized system or personnel, the contaminated content must be surgically redacted. This endpoint requires multi-signature authorization from two Superusers with clearance at or above SECRET.

Usage

# Heartbeat — keep session alive
POST /api/v1/auth/heartbeat

# Execute spillage purge
POST /api/v1/admin/security/spillage/purge
{
"incident_ticket_ref": "INC-2026-0042",
"search_terms": ["CLASSIFIED_PROGRAM_NAME"],
"purging_user_ids": [1, 2]
}

# Retrieve audit certificates
GET /api/v1/admin/security/spillage/audit-certificates

Admin Tools

Admin Tools Router — Combined endpoints for all admin capabilities.

This single router consolidates all admin tool endpoints to keep the router count manageable while providing full API coverage.

Endpoints

  • /admin/logs/* - Log management

  • /admin/config/* - System configuration

  • /admin/health/* - Service health

  • /admin/alerting/* - Alerting and notifications

  • /admin/monitoring/* - Monitoring and metrics

  • /admin/password/* - Password policy and 2FA

  • /admin/data/* - Data export/import

  • /admin/log-rotation/* - Log rotation

  • /admin/security-scan/* - Security scans

  • /admin/secrets/* - Secret rotation

  • /admin/maintenance/* - Maintenance mode

  • /admin/feature-flags/* - Feature flags

  • /admin/users/* - User management
